#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<int> dp(n + 2, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;
    int ans = 0;

    long long pairCount = (n + 1LL) * (n + 2LL) / 2LL;
    int i = 0, j = 0;

    for (long long p = 0; p < pairCount; ++p) {
        if (((i + j) & 1) == 1) {
            ans = (ans + dp[j]) % MOD;
        }
        dp[j + 1] = (dp[j + 1] + dp[j]) % MOD;

        if (j == n) {
            ++i;
            j = i;
        } else {
            ++j;
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
